On the Global Stage

Where AWA has shown up

From ministerial summits to UN panels, here's where AWA has represented youth voices in water governance.

2026

UN 2026 Water Conference, Special Accreditation

The only youth-led organization registered in Peru accredited for this landmark global conference.

2026

UN Climate Change Conference, Bonn (SB64)

AWA represented youth voices in water at the UNFCCC intersessional climate negotiations in Bonn, Germany.

2026

First Youth Water Forum, Piura, Peru

AWA took part in Peru's first-ever Youth Water Forum, bringing young voices directly into regional water policy conversations.

2026

MHPSS Conference, Nordic Red Cross

AWA's Executive Director delivered a keynote on the Nature Track, connecting water, nature, and mental health and psychosocial support.

2025

Ministerial Water Summit LAC, Lima, Peru

AWA joined as a delegation at one of the region's most significant water policy platforms.

2025

UN Youth Dialogue Perú (Diálogo Juvenil)

AWA led the environment panel as part of the International United Nations Youth Talks anniversary.

2025

ENAVOL National Volunteering Conference, Lima, Peru

AWA spoke at Peru's national conference on volunteering, opening new avenues for partnerships.

2025

Kectil Conference LATAM

AWA was invited to speak at the first Kectil conference in Latin America, focused on youth leadership and social impact.

2025

Climate Café, Por Mi Parque, Lima, Peru

AWA contributed to the international alliances and cooperation block on NDC reductions and the 2030 Agenda.

2024

World Bank Webinars, Young Water Professional Network

AWA co-organized two webinars: Indigenous youth perspectives on water in Latin America, and young women leaders in water.

2023

World Water Week, Stockholm, Sweden

As an Arup Young Water Professional, AWA's Executive Director represented the organization on the global stage.

2022

United Nations, International Youth Day, New York

AWA represented the organization at the UN alongside the AFS Youth Assembly.

Community & Education

Closer to home

Not every AWA event is on an international stage. Our most direct work happens in community.

2026

AWA Water Café, Barcelona (Upcoming, Oct 10)

Our first Water Café brings the community together to listen, exchange ideas, and connect over water. Get tickets above.

2026

Sustainability Fair, Colegio San Ignacio de Recalde

AWA ran an educational fair with students, bringing water justice and sustainability into the classroom for the next generation.
